steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. R-600a is flammable — follow sealed-system precautions when applicable.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power cord before servicing this appliance.

steps.title: Enter manual defrost (dF)
steps.body: On main UI: hold + and Air Filter buttons for 10 seconds. Display shows dF while manual defrost is active.
steps.sourceExcerpt: On main UI: hold + and Air Filter buttons for 10 seconds. Display shows dF while manual defrost is active.

steps.title: Defrost cycle effective?
steps.body: Allow manual defrost to run. Verify evaporator frost clears and compartment temperatures recover after dF completes and unit returns to normal operation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Allow manual defrost to run. Verify evaporator frost clears and compartment temperatures recover after dF completes and unit returns to normal operation.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Manual defrost did not clear frost — continue component diagnostics.

steps.title: Continue diagnostics
steps.oemOutcome: Frost or cooling fault remains — run Er t* sensor and heater service-mode tests.
